Spec-gate failures in CI are frequent (missing or malformed Spec: trailers, section citations in added lines). Catch them at commit time.

In a repo with a [gate] table, the commit-msg hook refuses a commit when:
- a staged path is guarded and neither this message nor a commit on the branch since its merge base with origin's default branch carries a valid trailer (WL-REQ-7), or the trailer it finds is malformed;
- a staged added line cites a spec section (WL-REQ-1791), skipping exempt paths.

Merge, cherry-pick and revert commits are not checked. `git commit --no-verify` bypasses it. Amend WL-REQ-1722 (the exceptions to 'no hook fails its event') and WL-REQ-1549 (the hook runs the gate locally) in the same change.
